condition: recombinant DyP-loaded WT T=1 shell expressed in E. coli
method:
X-ray crystallography; CAVER pore analysis; 
APBS electrostatic analysis
notes:
Five-fold major pore; CAVER bottleneck diameter 3.6 Å. Only slightly open and substantially less open than the corresponding pore in 
cryo-EM Mtb-Enc structures. Electrostatics are pH-dependent: exterior positive at pH 4.5 and strongly negative at neutral pH; interior neutral-to-slightly negative at pH 4.5 and negative-to-neutral at neutral pH.
